title: K-Bay Boat Rentals
specs: Boats permanently berthed at Homer Harbor, no towing or launching required
Dual Garmin GPS chartplotters and fishfinders on all boats
Safety equipment includes auto-launching EPIRB, inflatable emergency raft, multiple VHF radios, life jackets
Boats fully rigged with halibut and salmon fishing gear, downriggers, and built-in fish boxes
Operator must be 25 years or older with valid driver's license
Operator must have Boater’s Education certificate or USCG license, or verifiable saltwater experience and book by phone
Operator must attend mandatory orientation the evening before trip
Operator must comprehend written and verbal instructions in English
Everyone fishing 16 or older needs a current Alaska Fishing License before boarding
Children of any age may ride as passengers; child life jackets provided; children must be supervised and sign liability waiver
includes: Fully equipped boats with fishing gear, GPS chartplotters, VHF radios, life jackets, safety equipment, fish boxes, and porta-pottie
4 halibut rod/reel combos, 2 salmon/rockfish rod/reel combos, 2 downriggers, sinkers, nets, gaff, harpoon, club, cleaning supplies
Adult and child life jackets provided
Safety equipment including fire extinguishers, first aid kit, EPIRB, inflatable emergency raft, flare gun
gap: Exact duration of single day rental not explicitly stated
blurb: Rent fully equipped 22- to 24-foot boats from Homer Harbor for fishing and exploring Kachemak Bay. Orientation is mandatory the evening before the trip. Boats come with fishing gear, GPS, VHF radios, safety equipment, and life jackets.
extraNote: $300/day deposit required to hold reservation, non-refundable outside cancellation window · Remaining balance plus $2,500 security deposit collected at orientation; security deposit returned if boat undamaged · Orientation is mandatory; missing it forfeits deposit and boat will not be released · Full refund if cancelled 14+ days before rental, or if K-Bay cancels due to mechanical failure or Small Craft Advisory · No refund for no-shows, cancellations less than 14 days, intoxication, or safety turnaways · Operating range limited to 25 miles from Homer Harbor between Flat Island and Anchor Point; going outside voids agreement and forfeits deposit · Fuel is renter's responsibility; expect 30–5
